description: Brand_Allowlist (R2.2/R2.3/R2.4, R10.2). The small, reviewed set of single files permitted to contain the legacy brand strings MIHAS / KATC / Mukuba / Kalulushi and legacy MIHAS domains. Every other file under apps/admissions/src, apps/admissions/index.html, backend/apps, and backend/config is scanned by the brand drift guards (backend/tests/unit/test_brand_drift_guard.py and apps/admissions/tests/unit/brandDriftGuard.test.ts) and must NOT contain these strings. Paths are repo-root-relative and each entry names a SINGLE file (R2.3 — no whole-directory entries). Each entry is classified as exactly one of the four allowed classes (R2.2) and states why it cannot be removed yet. A new entry is a deliberate decision that the strings are legitimate tenant data, an allowlisted historical reference, named legacy-compatibility code with a guard, or a dev/PDF-preview fixture not reachable from official-download paths (R2.4) — never a reintroduced platform fallback.
legacyExceptionPolicy: Every entry is in exactly one of two populations, decided per entry by admissions-v2 task 12.5 pass 2 (2026-10-09, finding GATE-13.6-01) under the user's authorization, on behalf of this register's owning spec (beanola-production-readiness: Property 28 in both brand guards, and its task 3.2 wrote each entry's reason; the register was created by multi-tenant-beanola-remediation R10). (1) A Legacy_Exception carries 'owner' and 'removeBy'. 'removeBy' is task 12.2's announced window, backend/apps/common/compatibility_register.py COMPATIBILITY_SURFACES['catalog.legacy_institution_write'].end_date; test_brand_drift_guard.py fails if it drifts from that register, and both brand guards fail once the window closes, naming the two legitimate answers (remove the strings and the entry, or announce a new window in compatibility_register.py on purpose). The nine client-preview entries were removed with @/lib/pdf and the /dev previews (platform-simplification task 14.1). (2) An entry that is permanent by design carries 'owner', a 'reviewBucket' from task 12.5's vocabulary (canonical, test-fixture, immutable-evidence or comment) and 'permanentBecause', and NO removal date — a date on it would assert a removal nobody intends. Both populations stay staleness-checked. Owners are records, not inventions: beanola-production-readiness for the entries its review wrote, platform-admissions (admissions-v2's owner string in compatibility_register.py) for the three admissions-v2 registered. Evidence: docs/v2-evidence/12.5/README.md section 13.
classifications: named legacy-compatibility code with a guard

allowlist.permanentBecause: Tenant data, permanent by design: the command writes the existing MIHAS/KATC tenants' own InstitutionDocumentProfile rows (letter content, signatory, bank-account names) — the backend tenant configuration tech.md makes the official-document authority. Naming a tenant in its own seed is what tenant data is, so there is no removal to date; the entry ends only if the file stops naming them (staleness check).
allowlist.reason: Tenant seed fixture (R6.7): seeds the MIHAS RN, KATC COG, KATC EHT acceptance-letter document profiles as tenant rows. MIHAS/KATC are legitimate tenant data here, confined to this seed command. Cannot be removed: deleting the strings would break seeding the existing MIHAS/KATC tenant profiles.

allowlist.permanentBecause: Tenant data, permanent by design: seeds brand_name/colours/contacts/domains for the existing MIHAS/KATC tenants, idempotently and only into blank columns, and is the template for branding any future school. A tenant's identity is tenant data; no removal is intended, so no date.
allowlist.reason: Tenant branding seed command: seeds brand_name/full_name/colours/contacts/domains (incl. admissions@mihas.beanola.com, support@mihas.beanola.com, https://mihas.beanola.com) for the existing MIHAS/KATC tenants so official documents render styled. MIHAS/KATC are legitimate tenant fixture data here. Cannot be removed: required to seed the existing tenants' brand identity.

allowlist.classification: named legacy-compatibility code with a guard
allowlist.reason: Application-number resolver. MIHAS appears only behind the clearly-named, tested legacy single-tenant path (_LEGACY_INSTITUTION_CODE / _resolve_institution_code_legacy); the default flow uses the assigned institution code and falls back to the brand-neutral BNL. Transitional, so dated: _resolve_institution_code_legacy has zero production callers (its only consumers are two cases in backend/tests/unit/test_institution_code_resolution.py). Existing MIHAS application numbers are stored values on their own records and never pass through it, and the public tracking pattern (tracking_secret.LEGACY_IDENTIFIER_PATTERN) recognises any 2-10-letter institution code with no hardcoded prefix (admissions-v2 12.5 section 7.3, re-measured in pass 2).

allowlist.permanentBecause: Prose, permanent by design: the only brand string is one '#' comment giving the student-number format example 'MIHAS/26/00001' — an example tenant's code in documentation, with no runtime branch. Half 5 of scripts/v1_surface_telemetry.py classifies the hit as a comment; a brand string on a non-comment line here would surface there as unregistered.
allowlist.reason: Docstring example of the student-number format ('MIHAS/26/00001') — a historical sample reference in a docstring, not a runtime fallback. Cannot be removed without losing the documented historical format example.

allowlist.permanentBecause: Test fixture, permanent by design: seeds the V2 harness's two example tenants (MIHAS on mihas.localhost, KATC on katc.localhost) for the two-tenant isolation journeys; local/CI only, never production. Any harness seeding mechanism has to name two distinguishable example tenants — the module's 'Phase-0 interim note' is about seeding through models instead of the onboarding API, not about the names. If seeding moves into API-driven test code, this file stops containing the strings and the staleness check retires the entry.
allowlist.reason: V2 harness tenant seed (admissions-v2 task 0.4), REGISTERED by task 12.5. Creates the two same-shaped example tenants the two-tenant isolation journeys need — MIHAS on mihas.localhost, KATC on katc.localhost — sharing one canonical program, which is the realistic 'same program name across two schools' case TEN-07 and R18 exercise. MIHAS/KATC are legitimate tenant fixture data here and the module's own docstring says so: 'Both are example Institution tenants of the Beanola platform — never the platform identity itself.' Cannot be removed: the two-tenant harness journeys cannot seed two distinguishable tenants without naming them. Local/CI only — this command is never run against production.

allowlist.permanentBecause: Test fixture, permanent by design: the harness-only settings module lists the two example tenant hosts in ALLOWED_HOSTS and CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS so host-based tenant resolution works locally. It is loaded only by the harness stack, never by prod.py or staging.py, and it lives exactly as long as harness_seed_tenants.py's hosts do.
allowlist.reason: V2 harness Django settings (admissions-v2 task 0.4), REGISTERED by task 12.5. ALLOWED_HOSTS and CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS must list the two example tenant hosts mihas.localhost / katc.localhost so host-based tenant resolution (InstitutionContextService.resolve) works locally; without them the two-tenant isolation journeys cannot reach a resolved tenant context. Cannot be removed: they are the hostnames harness_seed_tenants.py creates. This settings module is loaded only by the harness stack, never by prod.py or staging.py.
